how.title: How it works
how.lead: You send a wine list. We set it up. Your staff and your guests start using it.

s1.title: Send your wine list
s1.text: In the format you have: PDF, Excel, CSV or a photo.

s2.title: We set it up
s2.text: We match each wine to our knowledge base and open access to your account.

s3.title: Staff and guests start
s3.text: Your waiter opens a link on the tablet. Your guests scan the QR code.

chains.title: For chains
chains.lead: More than one venue? Each venue keeps its own wine list.

i1.title: A list per venue
i1.text: Every venue has its own wine list and its own prices.

i2.title: Promoted wines
i2.text: Agree with us the bottles you want to push. They get a moderate boost in ranking.

i3.title: Priced per venue
i3.text: Pricing for three or more venues is quoted on request.

proof.title: Already working in restaurants
proof.text: Wineater is used in restaurants in France and Russia. We name a venue only with its permission.

cta.title: See it on your wine list

how.title: One script tag. Only what is in stock.

s1.title: Add one script tag
s1.text: Paste one line of code on your wine pages. The widget matches your store's branding.

s2.title: Stock syncs daily
s2.text: With stock sync on, we read your product feed once a day, so recommendations follow your stock.

s3.title: Only what you have
s3.text: Sold-out wines are hidden from the four picks.

promote.title: Promote what you need to sell
promote.lead: Mark the products you want to push: overstock, a margin, a new arrival.

i1.title: You choose

i2.title: A moderate boost
i2.text: Promoted products rank higher, but only when they fit what the shopper asked.

i3.title: Still your catalog only

cta.title: Start your free month

hero.title: Turn any restaurant's menu into a wine proposal from your portfolio.
hero.subtitle: Upload a photo or PDF of a restaurant's food menu. Wineater matches the dishes to your catalog and drafts a proposal your sales rep can edit and send.
hero.point1: Built on the same engine as the widget and the QR menu
hero.point2: Works from your price list: Excel, PDF or API

problem.title: Proposals take hours. Staff avoid the wines your margin depends on.
problem.lead: Sales reps lose hours building a proposal for each restaurant. And restaurant staff often fear selling complex wines, so the venue sells only the basic bottles and you lose margin.
problem.note: Wineater for distributors is in early access with design partners. Features below are in development unless stated otherwise.

modules.title: Four modules, one platform
modules.lead: A sales tool for your reps, a loyalty tool for your restaurants.

i1.title: B2B proposal generator
i1.text: Your rep uploads a photo or PDF of a restaurant's menu. Wineater reads the dishes and groups wines from your portfolio into pairings for them.

i2.title: QR loyalty menu for restaurants
i2.text: Give your restaurants a QR menu with a virtual sommelier. Your wines are marked as priority, so the sommelier ranks them higher when they fit the dish.

i3.title: Widget for your site
i3.text: A smart search on your online catalog: buyers write what they need instead of using filters.

i4.title: Data insights
i4.text: Portfolio gap analysis and a menu heatmap, built from the menus and requests you collect. A later phase.

flow.title: From a menu to a proposal
flow.lead: One session for your rep, from the restaurant's card to a proposal ready to send.

s1.title: Add the restaurant
s1.text: Create the prospect and upload a photo or PDF of its food menu.

s2.title: Check the dishes
s2.text: Wineater reads the menu. Your rep fixes anything it got wrong.

s3.title: Review the proposal
s3.text: Wines from your portfolio are grouped by dish category, each with a short reason. Replace, remove or pin any wine.

s4.title: Send it
s4.text: Share a link or export a PDF. After the deal, the restaurant gets a QR menu where your wines are marked as priority.

insights.title: See what your portfolio is missing
insights.lead: Two reports for the owner or the buyer. They need data to be useful, so they come after you have collected enough menus.

i1.title: Portfolio gap analysis
i1.text: Which wines people look for in restaurants that your catalog does not have: a list of purchase opportunities.

i2.title: Menu heatmap
i2.text: Which dishes and ingredients recur across the menus you have analysed, so you know which wines are missing from your warehouse.

cta.title: Want to shape it with us?
cta.text: We are building this with a first group of distributors. Talk to us about your portfolio.
